Bacche ke janam se ₹10,000/mahina SIP. 18 saal baad kitna? 👶➡️🎓

Aapki jeb se: ₹21.6 lakh
18th birthday pe: ~₹76 lakh (12%/saal maan ke, guaranteed nahi)

• Pehle 5 saal: ₹6L daale, bane sirf ~₹8.25L
• Aakhri 3 saal: ~₹26L judte hain
• 5 saal late shuru: ~₹37.5L, aadhi se bhi kam

Bacche ke liye sabse bada gift rakam nahi, TIME hai.

Save karo aur us parent ko bhejo jo "baad mein shuru karenge" bolta hai. Aapne kab shuru kiya? 👇
